name: Ephildis Agraliel
original_name: エフィルディス＝アグラリエル
source:
A high elf queen who governs over the Kingdom of Agraliel.
She is a wise ruler beloved by all who does not boast of her own accomplishments, all she does is for the people.
To stop the fighting between high elves and dark elves and allow the elf nation to flourish, she appointed Narrus as an imperial guard.
